# What does an aeration and overseeding job really make?

> Free bid calculator for lawn-care operators pricing aeration and overseeding: true profit, margin and the lowest quote that hits your target margin.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
